title: Daily Source Pass
summary: Today's issue is built from Metro Council, Metro Legistar, NDOT, Sports Authority, Office of Homeless Services, Ticketmaster, Nashville Music Calendar, and venue listings. Facebook and Nextdoor remain held unless supervised capture is available.

stages.goal: Find same-day official meetings and civic stakes.
stages.output: Confirmed the public-safety working group, Traffic and Parking Commission, and Sports Authority committee meetings.

stages.name: Transportation And Teardown

stages.output: Confirmed the CMA Fest special-event zone runs through midnight and attached NDOT closure materials.

stages.name: Housing Systems Scan
stages.output: Confirmed the Continuum of Care Governance Charter Committee meeting at Edgehill Branch Library.

stages.name: Monday Calendar
stages.goal: Build tonight's useful East-side event lane.
stages.output: Confirmed The East Room's Monday listing and nearby Basement music listings.

stages.name: Private Platform Gate
stages.goal: Use private-platform material only with supervised capture.
stages.output: Held Facebook and Nextdoor material because no supervised private-feed capture was available in this run.

stages.name: Publish Pack
stages.goal: Ship source-backed web stories and newsletter-ready copy.
stages.output: Seven June 8 stories are ready with source trails, labels, social cuts, and generated/fallback covers.
